name: The Price On A Head is offered on entering the cavern spot past Raigh Anramor after the Ealdir Trial of Strength
contract: Quest 175038 is no longer started by Raigh Anramor 164047. The invisible trigger 9920211 (spawn 9922300,
npc_coa_area_quest_offer) about 40 yd up the cavern starts it: a player who can take the quest and walks within
10 yd gets its quest window, again on every new entry until it is accepted, and accepting it adds the quest.
Expected: no offer stands before the player reaches the spot, and once there an accept request takes the
quest. The case joins world phase 1 to use the trigger's world spawn.

steps.label: Join world phase 1, where the trigger is spawned
Turn in The Ealdir Trial of Strength
An accept beside Raigh finds no offer
SETUP: the quest is not taken beside Raigh
Walk up to the offer spot
Walk back to Raigh without accepting
The Price On A Head is in the quest log
